# EMI Health Blog

> EMI Health's blog provides comprehensive guides for members, brokers, and employers on health insurance, preventive care, wellness programs, and benefit navigation.

The blog covers member education on insurance basics, wellness benefits, and health prevention; broker resources for selling EMI Health plans and understanding ASO models; and employer/group compliance with healthcare regulations. Key focus areas include the BeWell Platform, telemedicine, diabetes prevention, and vision health.

## Key Topics

- EMI Health
- Preventive Care
- Wellness Programs
- Health Insurance Basics
- Insurance Coverage
- Carrier vs Network
- In-Network Providers
- Diabetes Prevention
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Vision Care
- Telemedicine
- ASO (Self-Funded Plans)
- Explanation of Benefits (EOB)
- Preauthorization
- BeWell Platform

## Member Guides & Benefits

- [A Guide to Exclusive Member Wellness Benefits](https://blog.emihealth.com/members/a-guide-to-exclusive-member-wellness-benefits): EMI Health member guide to wellness benefits and BeWell Platform features
- [Understanding Your Covered Benefits and Preauthorization](https://blog.emihealth.com/members/understanding-preauthorization): Member guide to preauthorization and covered benefits process
- [Decoding Your EOB](https://blog.emihealth.com/decoding-your-eob): Guide to understanding Explanation of Benefits and insurance claims
- [Carrier vs Network: What's the Difference? Part 1](https://blog.emihealth.com/members/carrier-vs-network-whats-the-difference): Guide explaining carrier vs network differences for EMI Health members

## Health & Wellness Education

- [The National Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP)](https://blog.emihealth.com/the-national-diabetes-prevention-program-dpp): National Diabetes Prevention Program overview for Type 2 Diabetes prevention

- [Use TeleMedicine to Save Time and Money (infographic)](https://blog.emihealth.com/members/telemedicine-save-time-infographic): Infographic on telemedicine benefits for time and cost savings
- [Kick Off the New Year with All the Right Tools to Reach Your Health-related Goals](https://blog.emihealth.com/members/kick-off-the-new-year-with-all-the-right-tools-to-reach-your-health-related-goals): New Year wellness guide featuring BE WELL personalized health platform
